topic: Jimenez-Gjol sub-LSB dither 8-bit color banding suppression vs Mach-band quantization staircase rig
topic_zh: Jiménez-Gjøl 亚最低有效位抖动 8-Bit 色带抑制对比朴素硬舍入马赫带断层阶梯
scope: Deterministic Jorge Jimenez (SIGGRAPH 2014) & Mikkel Gjol (GDC 2016 Playdead INSIDE) 1-LSB dithered 8-bit quantization (E[floor(c + xi + 0.5)] === c) versus naive un-dithered 8-bit round-to-nearest quantization (floor(c + 0.5)) and 64-stratum spatial tile integration across 17 sub-LSB stations (c in [10.0000, 11.0000] LSB). No neural debanding execution.

protocol.function: E[floor(c + ξ + 0.5)] = (1 − u)·K₀ + u·(K₀ + 1) ≡ c → Midpoint Q(10.50) = 10.5000 LSB (0.0000 Staircase Error)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 sub-LSB gradient stations preserve exact linear quantization expectation without Mach-band terraces

good_fit: Final HDR-to-SDR 8-bit (UNORM8) post-process output in UE5, Frostbite, Unity HDRP, Playdead INSIDE, and Three.js
Eliminating visible onion-ring Mach bands in twilight sky domes, underwater volumetric fog, and soft vignette falloffs
Linearizing non-linear quantizers via 1-LSB uniform or triangular PDF Interleaved Gradient Noise (IGN)
Preventing 8-bit G-Buffer or LUT quantization staircases in deferred rendering
not_for: Floating-point HDR render targets (RGBA16F / RGBA32F) prior to final 8-bit/10-bit integer quantization
Lossless bit-exact cryptographic or ID buffers (object picking IDs, stencil masks) where any dither corrupts the integer ID
Neural video debanding or super-resolution networks
